package.description: The best way to use pi agent.

en-US.description: The best way to use pi agent.
en-US.longDescription: Pix is a desktop shell for the pi coding agent: a Codex-style UI that keeps configuration, packages, sessions, and tools on the native pi side (~/.pi/agent). Models, API keys, settings, packages, and tools match interactive pi; the last workspace is restored from desktop prefs. Built with Electron.
en-US.name: Pix

zh-CN.description: 使用 pi agent 的最佳方式。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pix 是 pi 编码智能体的桌面外壳：一个 Codex 风格的界面，把配置、Packages、会话与工具都保留在原生 pi 一侧（~/.pi/agent）。模型、API 密钥、设置、Packages 与工具都与交互式 pi 一致；上次的工作区会从桌面偏好中恢复。基于 Electron 构建。
